This is your first doc. Type `/` to insert headings, lists, checklists, tables or images.

## How everything connects

- **Meetings:** connect Google Calendar in Settings. In any meeting, tap *Take notes* and a doc is created with the date and attendees.
- **Action items into tasks:** write a checklist in any doc and use *Convert checklist to tasks*.
- **Claude sessions:** use *Import Markdown* or create a token in Settings, API, so Claude can save documentation right here.

## Shortcuts

- `C` creates a task from any screen
- `⌘K` searches tasks, docs and workspaces

guide.title: How to connect your Google mail
guide.description: There are three Google screens. The second one is a bit scary, but it is normal while Google finishes reviewing Veltro.
guide.step1Body: Your work email (Google Workspace) or your Gmail.
guide.step3Body: Tap “Select all” (mail, contacts, Drive and calendar) and then “Continue”.
guide.why: Veltro is new and Google has not finished verifying it yet: that is why it warns you. Your mail is not stored in Veltro (it is read from Google on the spot) and you can remove the permission anytime from your Google account.
guide.adminTitle: Do you manage your company’s Google Workspace? Remove the warning for everyone
guide.adminBody: Once, in the admin console, mark Veltro as a trusted app. From then on nobody in your company sees the warning:
guide.admin1: Go to admin.google.com with your admin account.
guide.admin2: Open Security › Access and data control › API controls.
guide.admin3: Click “Manage third-party app access” and then “Configure new app”.
guide.admin4: Search for Veltro (by name or client ID), apply it to the whole organization and choose “Trusted”.
guide.adminNote: This covers people in your company. People from other companies still see the warning until Google finishes verifying Veltro.
